job.question: For user No. 24, how many times is the number of posts compared to votes?

check.sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24
check.message: Fan-out: COUNT(T2.Id) sees each posts row 8x (24 joined rows vs 3 distinct) because of the JOIN (many-to-many: no table appears once per joined row). Deduplicated value: 0.375.
check.explanation: Each posts row is counted 8 times because the query also joins votes.
check.intended: If you meant to count every posts and votes pair, this is fine. If you meant to count each posts row once, use the fix.

corrected.sql: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(T2.Id) FROM "posts" AS "T2" WHERE "T2".rowid IN (SELECT "T2".rowid FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24)) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Id) FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.OwnerUserId WHERE T1.UserId = 24
